data.body: Closing: resolved by the peer session's Gerrit 2344 (c68cc1de3185, 'Resolve the sweep's code root, not compose it'), which carries rebar-ticket: 6bf1-326b-7404-4034, merged with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, and is an ancestor of origin/main.
